name: mymind
tagline: A private, AI-organized place to remember everything.
description: mymind is a personal memory tool: save notes, links, articles, images, and quotes, and it auto-tags and sorts them for you — no folders, no manual filing. AI recognizes what each item is (article, product, recipe, book) and surfaces it again through fast visual, associative search. It's built privacy-first, with no ads, no tracking, and nothing sold or used to train models.
insight: Independent and self-funded since 2020 with no outside investors and no venture capital taken.
edge: No folders, tags, or manual filing — AI auto-organizes every save into fast, visual associative search.
pros: No manual tagging or filing — AI sorts saves
Privacy-first: no ads, tracking, or training
Saves text, links, images, notes in one place
Native iOS, Android, Mac + browser extensions
cons: No free tier — paid subscription only
Personal use, not a team/collaboration tool

references.title: Building an extension of your mind with mymind
